name: Return to Quinn
label: Quest
description: At the Ivar Patch, Quinn Yorick waits for a draught that may let him travel again. Apothecary Renferrel sends you from the Sepulcher with the mixture…

clips.title: The story
paras: At the Ivar Patch, Quinn Yorick waits for a draught that may let him travel again. Apothecary Renferrel sends you from the Sepulcher with the mixture, while Quinn remains wounded in dangerous country.

After you gather wild beast hearts for the Royal Apothecary Society, Apothecary Renferrel brews a restorative draught for Quinn Yorick at the Sepulcher. He hands it over without ceremony and returns to his secret alchemical research. You carry the mixture back into the wilderness.

At the ruined Ivar Patch, Quinn Yorick hides beside his sister, Deathstalker Rane Yorick. The ghoul Ivar the Foul wounded him so badly he cannot cross hostile ground. Quinn drinks the draught as soon as you arrive. It restores enough strength for him to travel in time, though danger still surrounds the farmstead, with Ivar lurking nearby.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here is the potion to aid in Quinn Yorick's recovery.
Now if you will excuse me, I have very important work to continue...

clips.title: Progress
paras: My sister told me you were here to aid us. Is that true?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, I can feel it working. I will soon be able to travel.
You have done me a great favor, friend.
